hero.heading: Let guests explore.
hero.subheading: Bring your dishes to life with photography and interactive 3D. Let guests see selected dishes on their own table, then choose the ordering tools that fit your service.

how_it_works.title: Your menu. Your way of serving.
how_it_works.subtitle: Start with a visual menu, then choose the content and service options that suit your restaurant.

steps.title: Start with your dishes
steps.desc: Bring your menu, prices and photos. Build it yourself or choose a setup by our team.

steps.title: Choose the experience
steps.desc: Shape your photo feed, languages and branding. Add 3D models for the dishes you want guests to explore.

steps.title: Bring it to the table
steps.desc: Share by link, QR code or NFC. Choose a menu-only setup, staff ordering or guest ordering and payments.

features.title: An experience guests can explore.
features.subtitle: From the first photo to the next step in service, bring your food and your restaurant together in one menu.

items.title: Make the choice visual
items.desc: Invite guests into a photo feed, then give each dish room for its description, details and price.

items.title: Put a dish on their table
items.desc: Let guests turn selected dishes in interactive 3D, or use a supported phone to see them on their own table.

items.title: Keep your restaurant’s character
items.desc: Bring your own logo, colors and menu sections into an experience that feels like your restaurant.

items.title: Welcome guests in their language
items.desc: Offer your menu in the languages you choose, so guests can explore your dishes in a language they know.

items.title: Connect the menu to service
items.desc: Choose staff ordering with tables and a kitchen display, or guest ordering and payments, according to your plan and enabled services.

items.title: Add a menu assistant
items.desc: An optional AI add-on can help guests explore dishes and ask questions when enabled for your menu.

cta.heading: Give guests a feel for the dish.
cta.text: Bring your food, your identity and the way you serve into one visual menu. Choose your setup, then add the experiences that make sense for your restaurant.

seo.description: Bring your restaurant to life with photo menus, selected dishes in interactive 3D, and optional ordering and payments to fit your service.
